_readme: Source of truth for automated Pinterest pin creation. Read this file first. Only state facts that appear here; do not invent clients, projects, awards or numbers.

brand.name: Akdeinz Motion
brand.story: The mark joins an A and an M into one continuous form, built from parallel bands cut at 60°. Where the bands overlap, a soft fold catches the light, like film or ribbon pulled through a frame. Akdeniz is the Mediterranean: sharp coastlines, waves, sun on water, kept abstract and geometric.

visual_rules.background: #000000 (primary). White #FFFFFF or Fold Grey #E6E6E6 for inverted pins.
visual_rules.accent_rule: Blue appears in small, deliberate doses. Never a full blue background behind body content.
visual_rules.geometry: Flat bands with horizontal ends and 60° sides. Everything rises on the 60° axis. No gradients on the logo, no ornament.

typography.display: Inter Display Bold / ExtraBold, tight tracking (-2% to -4%)
typography.caption: Inter Regular, uppercase, +12% tracking

logo_rules: Use the supplied files only; white logo on black is primary.
Do not stretch, rotate, recolour the folds, outline, or add effects (glow, shadow).
Clear space around the logo equals the width of one band.
Minimum logo width on a pin: 120 px.
visual_rules.pin_format: 1000 x 1500 px (2:3). Keep text in the centre 80%; Pinterest crops edges in some feeds.

assets.note: Project videos are not uploaded yet. Until they are, build pins from brand graphics (bands, mark, palette) rather than claiming specific client work.

animated_pins.note: Ready-made 600x900 GIFs with title, description and alt text. Use image_url as the pin media source and the manifest 'link' as the pin link.

voice.tone: Confident, minimal, precise. Few words. No hype words like 'innovative', 'seamless', 'next-generation'.

status.note: Services and project names are not confirmed yet. Do not mention them.
